Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s search results and incorrectly concluded that Lion Air’s base/hub was in Bangkok (Don Mueang), conflating Lion Air with Thai Lion Air. This led to identifying Thailand (former name “Siam”) instead of Indonesia, despite sources indicating Lion Air’s main hub is Soekarno–Hatta International Airport in Jakarta, Indonesia (former name “Dutch East Indies”).
